newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunkers rise before Easter break.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers rise before Easter break.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices edged up on Wednesday on good demand ahead of the Easter weekend, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst bunker fuel rose to $90 a tonne from $88 on Tuesday, while 180 cst firmed to $96, some $2 firmer. Antwerp prices were about $1 lower than Rotterdam, dealers said.
"Demand is quite good as most people want to get into the market today or tomorrow before Easter," a Rotterdam dealer said.
Meanwhile, high sulphur barge prices rose on the back of concerted buying by a single purchaser.
Augusta bunkers firmed in dull trade to $99 for 380 cst and $104 for 180 cst, while Fos was steady at $91 and $97, respectively.
Algeciras prices edged up to $97 for 380 cst and $102 for 180 cst. One broker said prices could increase if current storms continue but vessels were currently loading as normal.
